claim: The 32-bit NVIDIA Vulkan ICD on the project PC (RTX 4090, driver 617.14, Windows 10.0.26200.9711) exposes VK_KHR_ray_query, VK_KHR_acceleration_structure and VK_KHR_deferred_host_operations to a 32-bit process (the 64-bit ICD of the same driver: all three)
notes: none of the three is present in the 32-bit list (nvoglv32.dll via nv-vk32.json, 270 device extensions), and neither are VK_KHR_ray_tracing_pipeline, VK_KHR_ray_tracing_maintenance1 or VK_NV_ray_tracing; the 64-bit run of the same driver lists all six (289 extensions, 19 only in 64-bit, none only in 32-bit); the rerun with implicit layers off (VK_LOADER_LAYERS_DISABLE=~implicit~) gives the identical 270-name list, so no overlay layer hides them; agrees with https://github.com/wannabuh/ao-vk/issues/22 (driver 621.01) and https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/cant-find-the-vk-nv-ray-tracing-on-32bits-application-works-on-64bits-driver-430-86/76896 (driver 430.86); decides drafted D50 (Liam)
